summary: P1 cache stability follow-up: make the append-only tool-history resource-safety valve pressure-aware. The static byte valve (batch_chars) folded already-sent mid-history tool results without real provider-visible pressure, zeroing the prefix cache for nothing; the valve now folds on measured anchored-view pressure (chars >= budget * 0.95) with the static threshold kept as the no-signal fallback. The cache-gate stable fp is composed with fold facts so it stops mistaking a rewritten view for an untouched prefix. Hard byte bound, tool pairing, recoverable receipts and rule/authorization freshness unchanged.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing episode-history projection, ingress prelude assembly and prompt build cache-gate fingerprint.
components.disposition: Add FoldPressureSignal (measured anchored-view chars vs effective budget, 0.95 safety ratio) and thread it from the ingress prelude (measured locally with the same provider-visible scope as build) through the projection valve; fold only under real measured pressure in append-only mode, keep the static byte valve as the None-signal fallback; carry measured chars/budget scope inside the fold trigger string. Compose cache_gate_stable_fp with fold boundaries/triggers via fold_aware_stable_fp so mid-history rewrites are reflected in the fingerprint. Function-size baseline re-registered per EVO-20261025-e0bff8ee for the three touched functions (236->254, 197->203, 197->210). No new assembly entry, no tool removed, no receipt deleted.
evidence: 306b5704 attribution: static 32k valve rewrote mid-history messages without real pressure; r10 hit -> r11 fold -> cache zeroed within 2 minutes (rules out provider cold cache); r20->r21 same chain.

TDD red-green: 8 new tests cover no-pressure append-only, real-pressure fold, legacy static fallback anchor, zero-budget no-invented-pressure, measured scope in trigger string, opportunistic-mode regression, tool pairing invariant and fold-aware fp composition.
Directed verification: 59 unit tests green (new 8 + projection 22 + briefing 29) plus ruff clean on all four changed files.

306b5704 design: pressure measurement reuses the existing provider-visible chars scope and the engine-refreshed last_budget_info.effective_budget; unparseable budget yields None (legacy fallback), never invented pressure.
components.verification_level: Directed local verification green; original full gate (ci_gate.sh) on the frozen tree plus R9 independent review pending at manifest writing; real-provider acceptance (mid-history fold trigger count, weighted hit rate) planned with the unified deployment.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Hard resource bound preserved (static valve as fallback, hard result cap untouched); receipts remain recoverable (fold trigger string carries measured scope); model evidence stays live (no briefing/freshness change in this lane); single-line reverts per site.
components.rollback_route: Revert the pressure parameter threading in episode_history.py/ingress_resolution.py/build.py; each site is a localized hunk; the static valve behavior is the fallback and remains the default without budget info.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing unit test suite for episode-history projection and prompt build.
components.disposition: Add permanent tests: pressure-aware valve semantics (no-pressure append-only, real-pressure fold, None-signal legacy anchor, zero-budget guard), measured scope evidence in triggers, opportunistic-mode regression, tool pairing invariant, and fold-aware stable fp composition.
evidence: 8 tests green locally; existing 22 projection tests stay green as regression anchors.
components.verification_level: Directed local verification green; R9 full-tree review covers the same tree.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Tests only observe; no runtime authority; no evidence deletion.

g1.necessity: Without real pressure the static valve still rewrote sent mid-history messages and zeroed the provider prefix cache; measured attribution (306b5704 r10->r11 within 2 minutes) shows the fold itself was the cache-killer in append-only runs.

g2.authority_owner: Host runtime prompt-build ingress assembly and episode-history projection subsystems; budget authority stays with the engine-refreshed last_budget_info.
g2.non_duplication: Reuses the existing provider-visible chars measurement scope and existing budget source; no new measurement pipeline, no duplicate valve, no new assembly entry.

TDD: red (ImportError) then green (8/8) on the new valve semantics; 22 projection regressions stay green.
g3.recovery_or_reason: Fallback is the unchanged static valve when no budget signal exists; fold receipts keep recovery refs and now carry measured chars/budget scope.
